verdict.rationale: Termius documents SFTP as a supported protocol. Its desktop SFTP view is dual-pane, managing local and remote files side by side, which covers transfers in both directions. You can switch from a terminal session to SFTP for the same saved host with one click, so the host's Keychain credentials appear to be reused. missing for 10: any evidence of SCP support, explicit documentation that SFTP sessions authenticate with configured Keychain keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration of file transfer.
